title: The Last Chapter: An E-mail You Need to Read
coreMove: Use mortality as a decision filter: let finite time shrink embarrassment, rank, and delay, then choose the next lived commitment.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A public yes may protect status while spending finite attention.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Steve Jobs at Stanford University in 2005 to test pride against mortality.
